benchmarks.name: Agent Arena Overall Net Improvement
benchmarks.task: Arena Agent Arena overall Net Improvement signal; aggregate score from real agent sessions, not a task pass rate

benchmarks.name: Agent Arena Confirmed Success
benchmarks.task: Arena signal based on explicit user confirmations that a task was completed; retain Arena aggregate score as reported

benchmarks.name: Agent Arena Praise vs Complaint
benchmarks.task: Arena signal derived from explicit user praise or complaint; retain Arena aggregate score as reported

benchmarks.name: Agent Arena Steerability
benchmarks.task: Arena signal derived from user correction effort; retain Arena aggregate score as reported

benchmarks.name: Agent Arena Bash Reliability
benchmarks.task: Arena bash reliability signal derived from agent-caused bash failures; retain Arena aggregate score as reported

benchmarks.name: Agent Arena Tool Hallucination
benchmarks.task: Arena signal derived from invalid or unavailable tool calls; lower rate is better

benchmarks.name: Code Arena: WebDev Overall
benchmarks.task: Human pairwise preference on multi-step web development tasks

benchmarks.name: Search Arena Overall
benchmarks.task: Human pairwise preference on LLM tasks with integrated web search

benchmarks.name: Vision Arena Overall
benchmarks.task: Human pairwise preference on multimodal tasks with visual inputs

presets.name: Arena leaderboards — October 2026
presets.reason: Dated Arena preference and Agent Arena signal snapshots. Arena rating points are relative preference ratings and are not accuracy; compare only within the same dated leaderboard. Agent signals are separate measures.

coverage_gaps.scope: Arena Text Arena category-specific leaderboards (Math, Coding, Instruction Following, Creative Writing, Expert, Occupational and other categories)
coverage_gaps.reason: This snapshot includes only overall Text Arena. Add each category (including Math, Coding, Instruction Following, Creative Writing, Expert and Occupational) as its own benchmark variant after exact configuration matching and source-backed row capture.

coverage_gaps.scope: Arena Document, Image-to-WebDev, Text-to-Image, Image Edit, Text-to-Video, Image-to-Video, Video Edit, and other non-text arenas
coverage_gaps.reason: Vision overall, Code Arena: WebDev overall, and Search Arena overall have reviewed snapshots. Other modalities and Arena categories remain separate leaderboards; they require their own source-backed variants and exact model/config mapping.

coverage_gaps.scope: Agent Arena categories Code, Chat and Work, and other signal leaderboards
coverage_gaps.reason: This capture covers Agent Arena Overall only; category and signal leaderboards are separate slices and are not inferred from the overall table.

coverage_gaps.scope: Arena rating comparisons across Text, Vision, Search and WebDev leaderboards or across snapshot dates
coverage_gaps.reason: Each arena/category is a distinct evaluation series; rating points are relative preference scores and should not be compared across categories or dates. This is documented as an interpretation constraint, not a missing score.
